title: A Creator Pack
description: This is simply my survival minecraft modpack. I use this to play the game with a higher FPS, and it has the tools I use to help me make videos!
body:
hi! I've made this modpack, simply for those who want to play the game with some performance mods but also for those who are wanting to create content on minecraft. The modpack contains mods that revolve around both making the game look beautiful and a way to capture it. For example, the "Visuality" mod adds subtle additions to the game to give it the tiniest bit of flare. Paired with the "Flashback" mod, you can actually record what you're doing and then later on playback what you did! which is great for cinematics.

Vanilla tweaks pack from the Official Vanilla tweaks Website.
https://vanillatweaks.net
